description: TomTom Safety Related Traffic Information API is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by TomTom Global Content B.V.. TomTom's Safety Related Traffic Information (SRTI) API is a webservice that delivers anonymized non-personal raw data on hazardous situations directly collected by TomTom's own applications. The content of the API includes anonymized, non-personal, crowd-sourced data from drivers using TomTom's AmiGO application that reports 'hazards' and 'broken down car' incidents on the road. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 2 resources in MSG_HTTP. The data standards named are datex-II, other. The national access point types are SRTI. The portal shows 2025-10-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
